usage: cox route chair [-h] {take,extend,beat,release,status,clear,chat} ...

positional arguments:
  {take,extend,beat,release,status,clear,chat}
    take                take the chair lock if no live chair holds it
    extend              move the end of the chair takeover this session holds
    beat                refresh the chair lock's heartbeat
    release             release the chair lock this session holds
    status              the chair lock's holder and computed state
    clear               remove the chair lock file, refusing a live holder unless --force
    chat                append to or read the leader chat thread (runs/leader.chat.jsonl)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
